@@name@@Decisive Strike@@icon@@Decisive Strike.png@@icon2@@{{{icon2}}}@@description@@'''Active:''' '''Garen''' [[File:Remove Scurvy.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Removal|An icon representing the keyword Cleanse]] [[:Crowd control#Removal|cleanses]] himself of all [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] and gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 35% '''bonus''' movement speed for a duration.@@description2@@Additionally, '''Garen''' empowers his next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] within 4.5 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], [[File:Bear Stance.png|20px|link=Dash#Lunge|An icon representing the keyword Lunge]] [[:Dash#Lunge|lunge]] at the target, deal '''bonus''' physical damage, and [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Silence|An icon representing the keyword Silence]] [[:Silence|silence]] them for 1.5 seconds.@@description3@@''Decisive Strike [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Garen's''' basic attack timer.''@@description4@@{{{description4}}}@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@

@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@none@@cost@@{{{cost}}}@@cooldown@@8@@targeting@@Auto@@damagetype@@Physical@@spellshield@@Special@@projectile@@@@notes@@ * The enhanced attack will apply other [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects and can [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] as normal (the bonus damage does not). ** The bonus damage will also apply [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] life steal. ** The bonus damage is applied to [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. * ''Decisive Strike'' locks '''Garen''' out of using basic attacks for a short period of time. This is shortened with [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] attack speed. * The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] during the [[:Attack speed#Windup|attack's windup]]. * ''Decisive Strike'' will not prevent the reapplication of [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] (e.g. the persistent slow from [[File:Trundle Pillar of Ice.png|20xpx|border|link=Trundle#Pillar of Ice|An icon for Trundle's ability Pillar of Ice]] [[Trundle#Pillar of Ice|Pillar of Ice]] will be immediately reapplied after removal if '''Garen''' is still within its [[area of effect]]). * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will only negate the [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Silence|An icon representing the keyword Silence]] [[:Silence|silence]]. * ''Decisive Strike's'' [[File:Bear Stance.png|20px|link=Dash#Lunge|An icon representing the keyword Lunge]] [[:Dash#Lunge|lunge]] can pass very thin terrain and will otherwise not be able to. In any case, '''Garen''' will still hit his target.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qi54mu_gxg]@@
